cards.short_description: AMD makes processors and graphics chips for PCs, game consoles, and data centers. You may know its Ryzen chips in laptops or Radeon graphics in gaming PCs.
cards.quarterly_summary: Revenue was a record $13.4 billion, up 45% from a year ago. Sales of chips for big data centers nearly doubled to $8.5 billion, while gaming chip sales fell 40%.
cards.why_line: You picked Gaming — AMD makes the processors and graphics chips inside many gaming PCs and consoles.

cards.short_description: Microsoft makes Windows, Office, Xbox, and cloud services many people use at work and at home. Xbox games, Game Pass, and Azure are part of everyday tech for millions.
cards.quarterly_summary: Revenue was $92.3 billion, up 19% from a year ago. Cloud kept growing fast; money from Xbox games and Game Pass was down a little, about 2%.
cards.why_line: You picked Gaming — Microsoft owns Xbox, Game Pass, and a big library of games people play every day.

cards.short_description: NetEase makes and runs popular mobile and PC games in China and around the world, including long-running hits and newer titles people play on phones and computers.
cards.quarterly_summary: Revenue was about 27.9 billion Chinese yuan (RMB, about US$4.2 billion), down 1.8% from a year ago. Games brought in about RMB22.9 billion (about US$3.4 billion), down 1.7%; NetEase reports in yuan, but its U.S. stock price is in dollars.
cards.why_line: You picked Gaming — NetEase makes some of the most-played mobile and PC games in China and beyond.

cards.short_description: NVIDIA makes the graphics chips that power many gaming PCs and the big computers that train AI. If you play on a high-end PC or see AI tools everywhere, NVIDIA is usually behind the scenes.
cards.quarterly_summary: Revenue was $115.8 billion, up 103% from a year ago. Sales of chips for big data centers were $107.6 billion, up 110%.
cards.why_line: You picked Gaming — NVIDIA makes the graphics chips inside many gaming PCs.

cards.short_description: Roblox is a free app where millions of people play games that other players build, and spend real money on Robux, its in-game currency, for outfits and extras.
cards.quarterly_summary: Revenue was $1.6 billion, up 16% from a year ago, but the money players spent on Robux fell 12% and daily players dropped 9% to 138 million, after a huge 2025.
cards.why_line: You picked Gaming — Roblox is one of the most-played game platforms in the world, especially with teens.

cards.short_description: Sony makes PlayStation consoles and games, plus headphones, cameras, and entertainment. If you play on a PS5 or listen with Sony earbuds, you already know the brand.
cards.quarterly_summary: PlayStation and its game services brought in about ¥1.21 trillion (Japanese yen), up 9% from a year ago, as more people paid for online services and bought games. Sony reports in yen, but its U.S. stock price is in dollars.
cards.why_line: You picked Gaming — Sony makes PlayStation consoles and many of the games people play on them.

cards.short_description: Take-Two makes popular video games such as Grand Theft Auto, NBA 2K, and Red Dead Redemption. It publishes games for consoles, PCs, and phones.
cards.quarterly_summary: Revenue was $1.50 billion, down from $1.77 billion a year ago. The company said Grand Theft Auto VI is set to launch on November 19, 2026.
cards.why_line: You picked Gaming — Take-Two makes hit games like Grand Theft Auto and NBA 2K.

cards.short_description: Unity makes the software tools many studios use to build video games for phones, PCs, and consoles. If a game feels smooth across devices, Unity may be behind it.
cards.quarterly_summary: Revenue was $622 million, up 32% from a year ago. Unity also made a profit of $122 million, after losing money in the same quarter last year.
cards.why_line: You picked Gaming — Unity makes the game-building tools behind many of the titles people play on phones and consoles.
